selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 修饰形容词、副词或动词，表示程度不大。
example_en: I feel a bit tired after the long walk.
example_zh: 走了很长一段路后，我觉得有点累。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 修饰可数名词复数，表示数量虽少但并非没有。
example_en: A few students stayed to clean the classroom.
example_zh: 几个学生留下来打扫教室。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可修饰不可数名词，也可表示程度较小。
example_en: There is a little milk left in the fridge.
example_zh: 冰箱里还剩一点牛奶。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可修饰动词表示程度，也可单独表示大量事物。
example_en: We learned a lot from the science project.
example_zh: 我们从这个科学项目中学到了很多。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或代词，说明信息来源或判断依据。
example_en: According to the map, the library is near the park.
example_zh: 根据地图，图书馆在公园附近。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于补充一个应当考虑的理由或事实。
example_en: Be patient with him; after all, he is new here.
example_zh: 对他耐心一点，毕竟他刚来这里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事物分布在某地的各处。
example_en: Wild flowers grow all over the hill in spring.
example_zh: 春天，野花开遍整座山丘。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示同意、接受，也可说明情况良好。
example_en: Do not worry; everything will be all right.
example_zh: 别担心，一切都会好起来的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某种情况在一段时间内持续发生。
example_en: The baby smiled all the time during the visit.
example_zh: 在探访期间，宝宝一直在笑。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示整个路程或过程没有中断。
example_en: We talked all the way home.
example_zh: 我们一路聊着回到家。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示事情按照平常的方式发生。
example_en: My father got up early as usual.
example_zh: 我父亲像往常一样早起。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常放在肯定句句末，补充同类的人或事。
example_en: Lucy can speak French, and she can speak Spanish as well.
example_zh: 露西会说法语，也会说西班牙语。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于否定句或疑问句，加强“任何程度”的含义。
example_en: I was not nervous at all before the speech.
example_zh: 演讲前我一点也不紧张。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于说明最初的情况，后文常出现变化。
example_en: At first, the puzzle looked difficult, but we soon solved it.
example_zh: 起初这个谜题看起来很难，但我们很快就解开了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常表示人在住所，也可表示处于熟悉自在的状态。
example_en: I will stay at home and finish my book tonight.
example_zh: 今晚我会待在家里把书读完。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调经过等待、努力或耽搁后某事发生。
example_en: The rain stopped at last, and the match began.
example_zh: 雨终于停了，比赛开始了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示数量或程度不低于某个限度。
example_en: Please read at least ten pages every day.
example_zh: 请每天至少读十页。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示不延迟地做某事。
example_en: When you smell smoke, leave the room at once.
example_zh: 闻到烟味时，要立刻离开房间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示两件事同时发生，也可引出与前文并存的另一面。
example_en: The twins reached the finish line at the same time.
example_zh: 这对双胞胎同时到达终点。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示每次只处理限定数量的人或事物。
example_en: Carry two boxes at a time to stay safe.
example_zh: 为了安全，每次搬两个箱子。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示某人正在工作，也可表示某种力量正在发挥作用。
example_en: My mother is still at work, so she will come later.
example_zh: 我妈妈还在工作，所以她会晚些来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示不用机器，而是亲手完成。
example_en: Grandpa made this wooden toy by hand.
example_zh: 爷爷亲手制作了这个木制玩具。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于转换到与当前话题相关的补充内容。
example_en: By the way, did you bring your library card?
example_zh: 顺便问一下，你带图书证了吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调某事持续进行或在白天和夜晚都发生。
example_en: The doctors worked day and night to help the patients.
example_zh: 医生们日夜工作，救助病人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于两人或多人之间的相互行为。
example_en: Good teammates listen to each other.
example_zh: 优秀的队友会互相倾听。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 作时间状语，说明动作每日发生；与形容词 everyday 区分。
example_en: I water these plants every day.
example_zh: 我每天给这些植物浇水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 作时间状语，说明动作每个星期发生。
example_en: Our class has a reading meeting every week.
example_zh: 我们班每周举行一次读书会。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 作时间状语，说明动作或事件每年发生。
example_en: Many visitors come to the town every year.
example_zh: 每年都有许多游客来到这个小镇。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某个动作或状态持续一段不太长的时间。
example_en: Let us sit here and rest for a while.
example_zh: 我们坐在这里休息一会儿吧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于引出能够说明前面观点的具体例子。
example_en: Some animals, for example, bears, sleep through much of the winter.
example_zh: 有些动物，例如熊，会睡过冬季的大部分时间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示获得某物或服务时不需要付钱。
example_en: Children can enter the museum for free on Sundays.
example_zh: 孩子们星期日可以免费进入博物馆。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于说明一个较长名称的简短说法。
example_en: We call the International Space Station the ISS for short.
example_zh: 我们把国际空间站简称为 ISS。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示说话人对某事很有把握。
example_en: I cannot say for sure when the bus will arrive.
example_zh: 我无法确切地说公共汽车什么时候到。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事间隔一段时间发生一次。
example_en: We visit our old teacher from time to time.
example_zh: 我们不时去看望以前的老师。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于祝愿别人顺利或成功。
example_en: Good luck with your English test tomorrow!
example_zh: 祝你明天的英语考试顺利！

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示分散在不同地方，不一定遍及全部区域。
example_en: Small cafés appeared here and there along the street.
example_zh: 街道两旁零星分布着一些小咖啡馆。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于给出全部数量。
example_en: There are thirty students in all in our music club.
example_zh: 我们的音乐社团总共有三十名学生。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 have 连用，说明人或事物具有相同点。
example_en: The two friends have a love of music in common.
example_zh: 这两个朋友都热爱音乐。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于补充真实情况，或纠正可能的误解。
example_en: The task looks simple, but in fact it needs careful planning.
example_zh: 这项任务看起来简单，其实需要周密计划。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于 wait 或 stand 等动词后，表示按队列排列。
example_en: Please wait in line outside the ticket office.
example_zh: 请在售票处外排队等候。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示事物排列整齐或处于适当状态。
example_en: Put the pictures in order to tell the story.
example_zh: 把图片按顺序排列来讲述这个故事。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于用简短的话概括前面的内容。
example_en: In short, regular practice is the key to improvement.
example_zh: 总之，经常练习是进步的关键。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示经过一段过程后的最终结果。
example_en: We tried several routes and chose the safest one in the end.
example_zh: 我们尝试了几条路线，最后选择了最安全的一条。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示阻挡通道或妨碍事情进行。
example_en: Your bicycle is in the way, so please move it.
example_zh: 你的自行车挡路了，请把它移开。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在最后时刻赶上，没有错过。
example_en: We reached the station just in time for the last train.
example_zh: 我们正好及时赶上末班火车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在当前时间之后的某个时候。
example_en: I am busy now, but I can help you later on.
example_zh: 我现在很忙，但之后可以帮你。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示数量或程度持续增加。
example_en: More and more students ride bicycles to school.
example_zh: 越来越多的学生骑自行车上学。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示紧邻的房屋或房间。
example_en: A friendly family moved in next door last week.
example_zh: 上周有一家友善的人搬到了隔壁。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示确信，也可表示某事极有可能发生。
example_en: No doubt, teamwork helped us finish early.
example_zh: 毫无疑问，团队合作帮助我们提前完成了任务。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与疑问词连用，引出不影响结果的条件。
example_en: No matter what happens, stay calm and ask for help.
example_zh: 无论发生什么，都要保持冷静并寻求帮助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示某事停止发生，也可说明数量已经没有剩余。
example_en: There is no more juice in the bottle.
example_zh: 瓶子里没有果汁了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事不经常但会间或发生。
example_en: We eat at that small restaurant now and then.
example_zh: 我们偶尔会去那家小餐馆吃饭。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示回答肯定、事情显而易见或愿意提供帮助。
example_en: Of course you can borrow my dictionary.
example_zh: 你当然可以借我的词典。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 be 连用，表示某物正在燃烧。
example_en: The dry grass was on fire, so we called for help.
example_zh: 干草着火了，所以我们打电话求助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某个行为是有意做出的，而非偶然。
example_en: She left the window open on purpose to let fresh air in.
example_zh: 她故意把窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to 连用表示去某地途中，也可表示某事即将发生。
example_en: We bought some bread on the way to school.
example_zh: 我们在上学路上买了一些面包。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在约定或规定的时刻，不早也不晚。
example_en: The school bus arrived on time this morning.
example_zh: 校车今天早上准时到达。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示同一动作或情况再次发生。
example_en: Once again, our class won the basketball game.
example_zh: 我们班又一次赢得了篮球比赛。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于请求或说明动作再重复一次。
example_en: Please read the last sentence once more.
example_zh: 请把最后一句再读一遍。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于警告不采取前述行动会产生某种后果。
example_en: Wear your coat, or else you may feel cold outside.
example_zh: 穿上外套，否则你在外面可能会觉得冷。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把原本可默念的内容说出声音来。
example_en: The teacher asked us to read the poem out loud.
example_zh: 老师让我们大声朗读这首诗。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调同一动作发生很多次。
example_en: He practiced the difficult line over and over.
example_zh: 他反复练习那句困难的台词。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示毫不拖延地采取行动。
example_en: Please wash the cut right away.
example_zh: 请立即清洗伤口。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与现在完成时连用，说明截至现在的情况。
example_en: So far, we have collected fifty books for the library.
example_zh: 到目前为止，我们已经为图书馆募集了五十本书。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调某种情况从过去持续到现在，或直到现在才改变。
example_en: Until now, I have never traveled by plane.
example_zh: 直到现在，我还从未坐过飞机旅行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示沿上下方向移动，也可表示来回走动。
example_en: The excited puppy jumped up and down.
example_zh: 兴奋的小狗跳上跳下。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示动作完成得好，也可用于接受建议或安排。
example_en: Mina plays the piano very well.
example_zh: 米娜钢琴弹得很好。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接所请求的人、物或帮助。
example_en: You can ask for help when the task is difficult.
example_zh: 任务困难时，你可以请求帮助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常后接较小的地点，也可表示经过思考得出结论。
example_en: We expect to arrive at the station before noon.
example_zh: 我们预计中午前到达车站。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常使用被动形式，后可接时间或地点状语。
example_en: The baby will be born in early spring.
example_zh: 这个宝宝将在初春出生。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接人或事物，表示相信其存在、价值或能力。
example_en: You must believe in yourself when facing a challenge.
example_zh: 面对挑战时，你必须相信自己。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接拥有者，通常不用于进行时或被动语态。
example_en: These gloves belong to my sister.
example_zh: 这副手套属于我姐姐。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指机器停止运转，也可指物质分解或人情绪失控。
example_en: Old buses may break down on long journeys.
example_zh: 旧公共汽车在长途行驶中可能会出故障。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指强行进入建筑物，也可指打断谈话。
example_en: Someone tried to break in through the back window.
example_zh: 有人试图从后窗闯入。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指把人或物带回，也可表示唤起记忆。
example_en: This song can bring back happy childhood memories.
example_zh: 这首歌能唤起快乐的童年回忆。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指降低价格、数量或水平，也可指使某物倒下。
example_en: Better farming methods can bring down food prices.
example_zh: 更好的耕作方法能够降低食品价格。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指把某物带回家，也可表示使人清楚认识某事。
example_en: The accident should bring home the importance of road safety.
example_zh: 这起事故应让人深刻认识到道路安全的重要性。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示某种情况需要某物，也可公开要求采取行动。
example_en: The problem will call for patience and teamwork.
example_zh: 解决这个问题需要耐心和团队合作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指提高声音喊话，也可指召集人员处理紧急情况。
example_en: If you see the guide, call out her name.
example_zh: 如果你看到导游，就大声喊她的名字。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可单独使用，也可接宾语表示使某人镇静。
example_en: Take a slow breath and calm down before you answer.
example_zh: 回答前慢慢吸一口气，让自己平静下来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示照料某人，也可用于较正式语境表示喜欢某物。
example_en: Nurses care for people who are ill.
example_zh: 护士照顾生病的人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在困难或中断后继续做某事。
example_en: Please carry on with your work while I answer the phone.
example_zh: 我接电话时，请继续做你的工作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示抵达酒店或机场后登记身份和相关信息。
example_en: We need to check in at the hotel before six.
example_zh: 我们需要在六点前办理酒店入住手续。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 查看；办理退房；结账离开
usage_note_zh: 可表示查看某物，也可表示办理离开酒店的手续。
example_en: Guests must check out before noon.
example_zh: 客人必须在中午前办理退房。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可不接宾语，也可接需要清理的地方或物品。
example_en: Everyone helped clean up the park after the picnic.
example_zh: 野餐后，大家一起清理了公园。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调沿某物向上移动。
example_en: The children watched the cat climb up the tree.
example_zh: 孩子们看着猫爬上树。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可用于邀请别人同行，也可说明事情的进展情况。
example_en: You may come along with us if you have time.
example_zh: 如果你有时间，可以和我们一起来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示返回原处，也可表示某种事物重新出现。
example_en: Please come back before it gets dark.
example_zh: 请在天黑前回来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从高处向低处移动，也可指价格或温度下降。
example_en: Snow began to come down before sunrise.
example_zh: 日出前开始下雪了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于表示人进入室内，也可指某物开始流行或到达。
example_en: Please knock before you come in.
example_zh: 进来之前请敲门。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于催促或鼓励，也可表示某事开始出现。
example_en: Come on, we do not want to miss the opening show.
example_zh: 快点，我们可不想错过开场表演。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从里面出来、书刊发行或信息被公开。
example_en: The new school magazine will come out next Monday.
example_zh: 新的校刊将在下周一出版。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示从别处来到说话人所在处，常用于非正式邀请。
example_en: Why not come over after school and study with us?
example_zh: 放学后为什么不过来和我们一起学习呢？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示向某处走近，也可指问题、机会或话题出现。
example_en: A question may come up during the class discussion.
example_zh: 课堂讨论中可能会出现一个问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示砍倒树木，也可表示减少数量或用量。
example_en: We should cut down the amount of plastic we use.
example_zh: 我们应该减少塑料的使用量。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示断开供应、联系或通路。
example_en: The storm may cut off electricity in some villages.
example_zh: 暴风雨可能会切断一些村庄的电力供应。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示用剪刀剪下，也可指去掉不需要的部分。
example_en: Use these scissors to cut out the paper star.
example_zh: 用这把剪刀剪下纸星星。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接影响结果的条件，或提供支持的人和事物。
example_en: The picnic will depend on the weather.
example_zh: 野餐能否进行将取决于天气。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示穿得正式，也可表示装扮成某个角色。
example_en: The children will dress up as storybook characters.
example_zh: 孩子们会装扮成故事书中的人物。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后常接动名词、形容词或介词短语，表示意外或最终结果。
example_en: Without a map, we might end up in the wrong village.
example_zh: 没有地图，我们最后可能会走到错误的村庄。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示从清醒状态进入睡眠，fall 在句中随时态变化。
example_en: It was hard to fall asleep because of the noise outside.
example_zh: 因为外面的噪声，很难入睡。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指人或物倒在地上，也可指建筑物倒塌。
example_en: Be careful not to fall down on the wet floor.
example_zh: 小心别在湿滑的地板上摔倒。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后面可直接接所离开的物体，不再加 from。
example_en: Loose buttons may fall off this old coat.
example_zh: 这件旧外套上松动的纽扣可能会脱落。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调失去平衡而倒下，可用于人或直立物体。
example_en: The chair may fall over if you lean back too far.
example_zh: 如果你向后仰得太多，椅子可能会翻倒。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 主语通常是动物，后接其食物。
example_en: Many small birds feed on seeds and insects.
example_zh: 许多小鸟以种子和昆虫为食。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词可表示想做某事，也可表示某种感受。
example_en: I feel like taking a short walk after dinner.
example_zh: 晚饭后我想散一会儿步。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示填写表格中的信息，也可表示临时代替某人。
example_en: Please fill in your name and class on this form.
example_zh: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名和班级。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示容器或空间变满，也可接宾语表示把某物装满。
example_en: We need to fill up the water bottles before the hike.
example_zh: 徒步前我们需要把水瓶装满。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示通过询问、调查或观察获得未知信息。
example_en: Let us find out why the computer will not start.
example_zh: 我们来查明电脑为什么无法启动。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 with 连用表示与某人相处，也可说明事情进展情况。
example_en: The new classmates get along well with one another.
example_zh: 新同学们彼此相处得很好。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示离开某地，或从危险和控制中逃脱。
example_en: The thief tried to get away through the crowded market.
example_zh: 小偷试图穿过拥挤的市场逃走。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示回到原处，也可表示重新得到某物。
example_en: We should get back to camp before sunset.
example_zh: 我们应该在日落前返回营地。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示移动到低处、记下内容或使人情绪低落。
example_en: Use the ladder to get down from the roof safely.
example_zh: 用梯子安全地从屋顶下来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示进入车辆或场所，也可表示交通工具到达。
example_en: We can get in through the side door.
example_zh: 我们可以从侧门进去。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接地点、状态或活动，含义取决于宾语。
example_en: Do not get into a car with a stranger.
example_zh: 不要上陌生人的车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常表示离开公共交通工具，也可表示从某物上下来。
example_en: We need to get off the bus at the next stop.
example_zh: 我们需要在下一站下车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示登上公共交通工具，也可与 with 连用表示进展或相处。
example_en: Hurry, or we will not get on the train in time.
example_zh: 快点，否则我们不能及时上火车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示从室内、车辆或某种处境中离开。
example_en: Use the rear door to get out of the building.
example_zh: 请从后门离开这栋楼。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示成功处理困难、情绪或疾病带来的影响。
example_en: With enough rest, you will soon get over the cold.
example_zh: 充分休息后，你很快就会从感冒中恢复。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示通过考试或困难阶段、做完任务，也可表示电话接通。
example_en: We worked together to get through the difficult task.
example_zh: 我们共同努力完成了这项困难的任务。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示人们来到一起参加活动或共同做事。
example_en: Our whole family will get together during the holiday.
example_zh: 假期里我们全家会团聚。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常表示离开床铺，也可表示从坐姿或卧姿站起。
example_en: I usually get up at half past six on school days.
example_zh: 上学日我通常六点半起床。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词，表示停止尝试或不再保持某种习惯。
example_en: Do not give up when the first attempt fails.
example_zh: 第一次尝试失败时不要放弃。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于允许或鼓励某人开始行动，也可表示继续前进。
example_en: If you are ready, go ahead and open the box.
example_zh: 如果你准备好了，就打开盒子吧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示离开当前地点，也可指问题或感觉消失。
example_en: The pain did not go away after a night's rest.
example_zh: 休息一夜后，疼痛并没有消失。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示返回原地，也可表示某事物起源于过去某时。
example_en: I need to go back home for my notebook.
example_zh: 我得回家拿笔记本。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指位置、温度、价格或数量降低。
example_en: The temperature may go down quickly after sunset.
example_zh: 日落后气温可能迅速下降。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: home 在这里作副词，前面通常不用介词 to。
example_en: Let us go home before the heavy rain starts.
example_zh: 我们在大雨开始前回家吧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示从外部进入某个地方。
example_en: The shop is open, so we can go in now.
example_zh: 商店开门了，我们现在可以进去。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接地点可表示进入，也可表示深入讨论或开始某种职业。
example_en: The teacher will go into more detail after the break.
example_zh: 休息后老师会讲得更详细。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示动作继续进行，也可询问正在发生什么。
example_en: The outdoor concert will go on despite the light rain.
example_zh: 尽管下着小雨，露天音乐会仍将继续。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示离开家参加活动，也可指灯或火熄灭。
example_en: The lights may go out during the storm.
example_zh: 暴风雨期间可能会停电。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示再次查看学习内容或认真检查细节。
example_en: Let us go over the new words before the quiz.
example_zh: 小测验前我们复习一下生词吧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示经历困难、逐项检查或从某处穿过。
example_en: We must go through every answer before handing in the paper.
example_zh: 交卷前我们必须检查每个答案。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示为了睡觉而上床，通常用于描述作息。
example_en: You should go to bed early before an important exam.
example_zh: 重要考试前你应该早点睡觉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指位置、价格、温度或数量升高。
example_en: Food prices sometimes go up before a long holiday.
example_zh: 长假前食品价格有时会上涨。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示人或动物逐渐成年，也可谈论成长地点或经历。
example_en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
example_zh: 你长大后想做什么？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把作业、文件或物品交给负责人。
example_en: Please hand in your homework before Friday.
example_zh: 请在星期五之前交作业。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可用于让人等待，也可表示牢牢抓住或坚持下去。
example_en: Hang on for a minute while I find the key.
example_zh: 请稍等一分钟，我找一下钥匙。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在别人需要时提供实际帮助。
example_en: Could you help out at the school fair this Saturday?
example_zh: 这个星期六你能在学校义卖会上帮忙吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可用于电话中请对方等待，也可表示紧紧抓住。
example_en: Hold on to the rail as you walk down the steps.
example_zh: 下台阶时请抓紧扶手。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于催促某人加快动作，也可表示自己加快速度。
example_en: Hurry up, or the movie will begin without us.
example_zh: 快点，否则电影开始时我们还没到。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示让人或物留在某处，也可表示控制情绪不表露。
example_en: The teacher may keep in students who have not finished the task.
example_zh: 老师可能会让没有完成任务的学生留在教室里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接动名词，强调反复或持续做某事。
example_en: If you keep on practicing, your pronunciation will improve.
example_zh: 如果你继续练习，发音会有所提高。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示保持某种水平，也可与 with 连用表示跟上进度。
example_en: Walk faster so that you can keep up with the group.
example_zh: 走快一点，这样你就能跟上队伍。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后常接带 to 的动词不定式，说明具备做某事的方法或技能。
example_en: Do you know how to use this fire extinguisher?
example_zh: 你知道怎样使用这个灭火器吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: lay 是及物动词，后接宾语，可指放置物品或制定规则。
example_en: Please lay down the tools when you finish the job.
example_zh: 完成工作后，请把工具放下。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 向某人学习；从某事中吸取经验
usage_note_zh: 后接学习的对象、经历或错误。
example_en: We can learn from our mistakes and do better next time.
example_zh: 我们可以从错误中吸取经验，下次做得更好。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示不再抓住某物，也可表示放下某种情绪。
example_en: Do not let go of the rope until I tell you.
example_zh: 在我告诉你之前不要松开绳子。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: let 与 in 之间可放代词或名词作宾语。
example_en: Please open the curtains and let in some sunlight.
example_zh: 请拉开窗帘，让阳光照进来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示让人或动物出去、泄露信息，或发出叫声。
example_en: Please open the gate and let out the dog.
example_zh: 请打开大门，让狗出去。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: lie 表示“躺”时是不及物动词，过去式为 lay。
example_en: You should lie down and rest if you feel dizzy.
example_zh: 如果你感到头晕，应该躺下休息。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: to 后接所听的人、声音或内容，listen 本身不能直接接宾语。
example_en: Please listen to the instructions before you begin.
example_zh: 开始之前请听清说明。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接国家、城市、建筑物等居住地点。
example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the sea.
example_zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 以某物为食；靠某物生活
usage_note_zh: 可说明食物来源，也可说明赖以生活的收入或资源。
example_en: In this area, many families live on fishing.
example_zh: 在这个地区，许多家庭靠捕鱼为生。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要照顾的人、动物或事物。
example_en: Can you look after my cat while I am away?
example_zh: 我不在时你能照顾我的猫吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接观看或检查的对象，强调把视线转向某物。
example_en: Look at the clouds and tell me what shapes you see.
example_zh: 看看这些云，告诉我你看到了什么形状。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示向身后看，也可与 on 连用表示回顾往事。
example_en: When I look back on the trip, I remember the kind people most.
example_zh: 回顾那次旅行时，我最记得那些善良的人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接想找到的人或事物，强调寻找的过程。
example_en: We need to look for a safe place to cross the road.
example_zh: 我们需要找一个安全的地方过马路。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或代词，询问外貌时常用 what 作宾语。
example_en: That island can look like a sleeping bear from here.
example_zh: 从这里看，那座岛可能像一只熟睡的熊。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 单独使用常表示警告，也可与 of 连用表示从某处向外看。
example_en: Look out! A bicycle is coming around the corner.
example_zh: 当心！一辆自行车正从拐角处过来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示在资料中查找信息，也可表示向上看。
example_en: You can look up the word in an online dictionary.
example_zh: 你可以在在线词典中查这个单词。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示观点可以理解、符合逻辑，常用于否定句或疑问句。
example_en: Your plan will make sense if we have enough time.
example_zh: 如果我们有足够的时间，你的计划就行得通。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接 that 从句或 of 短语，表示确认某事无误。
example_en: Please make sure that every window is closed.
example_zh: 请确保每扇窗户都关好了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 含义随宾语和语境变化，也可表示构成整体的一部分。
example_en: Do not make up an excuse for being late.
example_zh: 不要为迟到编造借口。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在某一区域内改变位置或到处活动。
example_en: Passengers may move around after the seat belt sign is off.
example_zh: 安全带指示灯熄灭后，乘客可以走动。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示开始在新的房屋或地点居住。
example_en: Our new neighbors will move in next weekend.
example_zh: 我们的新邻居下周末会搬进来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示离开当前地点、话题或阶段，继续下一步。
example_en: After a short rest, the hikers decided to move on.
example_zh: 短暂休息后，徒步者决定继续前进。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示离开原来居住的房屋或地点。
example_en: They plan to move out at the end of the month.
example_zh: 他们计划在月底搬出去。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 为某物付款；为某事付出代价
usage_note_zh: 后接购买的物品、服务或行为造成的后果。
example_en: I used my own money to pay for the notebook.
example_zh: 我用自己的钱买了这个笔记本。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从一组中选择，也可表示从人群或背景中认出。
example_en: Help me pick out a present for my little brother.
example_zh: 帮我给弟弟挑一件礼物。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示拿起物品、开车接人或自然学到知识和技能。
example_en: Could you pick up that piece of paper from the floor?
example_zh: 你能把地上的那张纸捡起来吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接玩伴、玩具或被随意摆弄的物品。
example_en: The children like to play with building blocks.
example_zh: 孩子们喜欢玩积木。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示让别人注意某个事实、问题或特征。
example_en: The guide will point out the oldest building in the town.
example_zh: 导游会指出镇上最古老的建筑。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接考试、活动或可能发生的情况。
example_en: We need to prepare for the school sports day.
example_zh: 我们需要为学校运动会做准备。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从里面取出物品、车辆驶离，或停止参与。
example_en: The dentist had to pull out the damaged tooth.
example_zh: 牙医不得不拔掉那颗坏牙。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把物品放到低处、记录内容或用言语贬低别人。
example_en: Please put down the glass before you open the door.
example_zh: 开门前请把玻璃杯放下。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把物品放进某处、安装设备或投入时间和精力。
example_en: We need to put in a new battery before using the clock.
example_zh: 使用这个钟之前，我们需要装入一节新电池。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可接衣物或配饰，也可表示安排演出或增加重量。
example_en: Put on your helmet before you ride the bicycle.
example_zh: 骑自行车前戴上头盔。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示灭火或关灯，也可表示生产、发布信息。
example_en: Use sand to put out a small campfire safely.
example_zh: 用沙子安全地扑灭小篝火。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把不同部分组合成整体，也可指组织材料或想法。
example_en: It took us an hour to put together the new bookshelf.
example_zh: 我们花了一个小时组装新书架。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把东西固定在高处、搭建临时设施或举起物品。
example_en: The students will put up posters for the book fair.
example_zh: 学生们会为书展张贴海报。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示为了逃避危险、控制或责任而离开。
example_en: The frightened horse tried to run away from the noise.
example_zh: 受惊的马试图逃离噪声。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 偶然遇见；撞上；遇到困难
usage_note_zh: 后接偶遇的人、碰撞的物体或意外出现的问题。
example_en: I often run into my old neighbor at the market.
example_zh: 我经常在市场偶遇以前的邻居。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 主语通常是供应物本身；表示某人用完某物时常接 of。
example_en: Our drinking water may run out before we reach camp.
example_zh: 我们可能在到达营地前耗尽饮用水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示开始旅程、着手实现目标，或清楚陈述内容。
example_en: We plan to set out before sunrise tomorrow.
example_zh: 我们计划明天日出前出发。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示创建组织、安装设备或安排活动。
example_en: The school will set up a new science club this term.
example_zh: 学校本学期将成立一个新的科学社团。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某人到达约定地点，常含终于出现或意外出现的意味。
example_en: Please show up ten minutes before the meeting begins.
example_zh: 请在会议开始前十分钟到场。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示关闭机器、系统或机构，常指停止运行。
example_en: Remember to shut down the computer before you leave.
example_zh: 离开前记得关闭电脑。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示到场登记，也可表示进入计算机账户。
example_en: Visitors must sign in at the front desk.
example_zh: 访客必须在前台登记。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示从站立状态变为坐姿，也可用于礼貌地请人入座。
example_en: Please sit down and wait for your name to be called.
example_zh: 请坐下等待叫到你的名字。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示降低移动速度，也可指放慢工作或生活节奏。
example_en: Drivers should slow down near the school gate.
example_zh: 驾驶员在学校门口附近应减速。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 和某人说话；对某人讲话
usage_note_zh: 后接谈话对象，也可表示就某个问题与某人交涉。
example_en: I would like to speak to the person in charge.
example_zh: 我想和负责人谈一谈。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示提高音量，也可表示公开说出意见。
example_en: Please speak up so that everyone can hear you.
example_zh: 请大声一点，让大家都能听见。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从坐姿起立，也可与 for 连用表示支持或维护。
example_en: Please stand up when the guests enter the room.
example_zh: 客人进入房间时请起立。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示到了通常睡觉的时间仍保持清醒。
example_en: Do not stay up too late before a school day.
example_zh: 上学日前不要熬夜太晚。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示进入某处，也常指为了帮助或制止问题而介入。
example_en: A teacher had to step in and stop the argument.
example_zh: 一位老师不得不介入并制止争论。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接计划、规则、决定或观点，表示不偏离或不放弃。
example_en: If we stick to the plan, we can finish before noon.
example_zh: 如果我们坚持按计划做，就能在中午前完成。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示关闭电器、灯或设备的电源。
example_en: Please switch off the fan when you leave the room.
example_zh: 离开房间时请关掉风扇。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示接通电器、灯或设备的电源。
example_en: Could you switch on the light in the hallway?
example_zh: 你能打开走廊里的灯吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可单独用于提醒或告别；表示照顾某人时通常接 of。
example_en: Take care when you cross this busy road.
example_zh: 穿过这条繁忙的道路时要当心。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从高处拿下、记录信息或拆除结构。
example_en: Please take down the phone number before you forget it.
example_zh: 请在忘记前记下这个电话号码。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可接衣物作宾语，也可不接宾语表示飞机离地。
example_en: The plane will take off in twenty minutes.
example_zh: 飞机将在二十分钟后起飞。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 in 连用，后接活动、比赛或讨论。
example_en: Every student can take part in the art festival.
example_zh: 每名学生都可以参加艺术节。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 主语通常是事件或活动，不用于被动语态。
example_en: The final match will take place on Saturday afternoon.
example_zh: 决赛将在星期六下午举行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示培养兴趣、占用时间或空间，也可表示拿起事物。
example_en: Reading does not have to take up all your free time.
example_zh: 阅读不必占用你全部的空闲时间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接谈话的主题或事情。
example_en: Let us talk about our plans for the summer holiday.
example_zh: 我们来谈谈暑假计划吧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接谈话对象；强调双方交流时也常用 talk with。
example_en: You should talk to a teacher if you need advice.
example_zh: 如果你需要建议，应该和老师谈谈。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要认真考虑的人、事或行动。
example_en: Please think about the question before you answer.
example_zh: 回答前请认真思考这个问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示脑中出现某人或某事，也可用于询问看法。
example_en: Can you think of a better name for our team?
example_zh: 你能为我们的队伍想出一个更好的名字吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接不再需要的东西；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。
example_en: Do not throw away paper that can be reused.
example_zh: 不要扔掉可以重复使用的纸。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示关闭电器、水源或设备；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。
example_en: Remember to turn off the tap after washing your hands.
example_zh: 洗手后记得关水龙头。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示开启电器、水源或设备；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。
example_en: Could you turn on the radio for the weather report?
example_zh: 你能打开收音机听天气预报吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常接形容词或不定式说明最终结果，也可表示关灯。
example_en: The missing keys may turn out to be in your bag.
example_zh: 丢失的钥匙最后可能会发现就在你的包里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接方向、对象或可以提供帮助的人。
example_en: You can turn to your parents when you face a difficult choice.
example_zh: 面临艰难选择时，你可以向父母求助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可不接宾语表示醒来，也可接宾语表示把某人叫醒。
example_en: I usually wake up before my alarm rings.
example_zh: 我通常在闹钟响之前醒来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示运动前活动身体，也可表示使食物或房间变暖。
example_en: Players should warm up before they enter the game.
example_zh: 运动员上场比赛前应该热身。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于提醒某人注意眼前或即将出现的危险。
example_en: Watch out! The steps are covered with ice.
example_zh: 当心！台阶上结了冰。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在某处工作；以某材料创作
usage_note_zh: 后接行业、地点、领域或艺术创作所用材料。
example_en: Many young people hope to work in science and technology.
example_zh: 许多年轻人希望在科技领域工作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接正在处理的任务、项目或需要改善的能力。
example_en: We will work on the class newspaper after lunch.
example_zh: 午饭后我们将制作班级报纸。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示找到答案、计算结果，也可表示进行体育锻炼。
example_en: Try to work out the answer without a calculator.
example_zh: 试着不用计算器算出答案。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要记录的信息；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。
example_en: Write down three things you learned today.
example_zh: 写下你今天学到的三件事。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示空间距离近，也可表示数量或关系接近。
example_en: Our school is close to the city library.
example_zh: 我们学校离市图书馆很近。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示空间距离远，也可强调实际情况与某种描述相差很大。
example_en: The campsite is far from the nearest town.
example_zh: 营地离最近的城镇很远。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示处于某人或某物外部的前方，与 in the front of 区分。
example_en: A large tree stands in front of our classroom.
example_zh: 我们的教室前面有一棵大树。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: to 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
example_en: We look forward to meeting the exchange students.
example_zh: 我们期待见到交换生。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于疑问词后加强语气，也可按字面表示在地球上。
example_en: Why on earth is the classroom door locked?
example_zh: 教室门到底为什么锁着？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形，表示过去的习惯或状态如今已经改变。
example_en: We used to play football in this field after school.
example_zh: 我们过去常常放学后在这片场地踢足球。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或不定式，比 want 语气更礼貌。
example_en: I would like to ask one more question.
example_zh: 我想再问一个问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形，可用于多种时态说明具备能力或条件。
example_en: With more practice, you will be able to swim farther.
example_zh: 多加练习后，你就能游得更远。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，说明害怕的对象。
example_en: It is normal to be afraid of making mistakes at first.
example_zh: 起初害怕犯错是正常的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于比较两个人或事物之间的差异。
example_en: Life in a small town can be different from life in a large city.
example_zh: 小镇生活可能与大城市生活不同。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接构成内容或大量存在的人和事物。
example_en: The garden will be full of flowers in May.
example_zh: 五月时花园里将开满鲜花。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，说明擅长的领域或活动。
example_en: You do not need to be good at everything.
example_zh: 你不必样样都擅长。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，说明兴趣所在。
example_en: More students may be interested in science after the visit.
example_zh: 参观后，可能会有更多学生对科学感兴趣。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接课程、会议、活动等被耽误的事情。
example_en: Leave now, or you may be late for the first class.
example_zh: 现在就走，否则你第一节课可能会迟到。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 为某人或某事感到自豪
usage_note_zh: 后接值得自豪的人、成就或行为。
example_en: Your family will be proud of your honest choice.
example_zh: 你的家人会为你诚实的选择感到自豪。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接出生地、来源地或事物的根源。
example_en: These oranges come from a farm in the south.
example_zh: 这些橙子来自南方的一座农场。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 采用 go 加动名词结构，表示去参加某项休闲活动。
example_en: We often go swimming at the sports center on Sundays.
example_zh: 星期日我们经常去体育中心游泳。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 与某物相配；和某人一起去
usage_note_zh: 可表示衣物、颜色等协调，也可表示陪同。
example_en: This blue scarf will go with your white coat.
example_zh: 这条蓝围巾与你的白外套很相配。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于从早晨到中午前见面时的问候。
example_en: Good morning, everyone. Please open your books.
example_zh: 大家早上好，请打开课本。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于祝愿或描述某人在活动中享受快乐时光。
example_en: I hope you have a good time at the school festival.
example_zh: 希望你在校园节上玩得开心。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可单独使用，也可接动名词说明从某项活动中获得乐趣。
example_en: Work safely and have fun during the experiment.
example_zh: 实验时既要注意安全，也要享受其中的乐趣。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 收到某人的来信或消息
usage_note_zh: 后接消息的发送者，而不是所收到的具体内容。
example_en: I hope to hear from my pen friend soon.
example_zh: 我希望很快收到笔友的消息。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接被嘲笑的人或引人发笑的事物。
example_en: It is unkind to laugh at someone who makes a mistake.
example_zh: 嘲笑犯错的人是不友善的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接微笑所面对的人或事物。
example_en: The little girl began to smile at her reflection.
example_zh: 小女孩开始对着自己的倒影微笑。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接家庭成员，表示外貌或性格与其相似。
example_en: I take after my father in both appearance and character.
example_zh: 我的外貌和性格都像父亲。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可单独使用，也可接 of 表示拍摄的对象。
example_en: Visitors may take photos in the garden but not inside the house.
example_zh: 游客可以在花园拍照，但不能在房屋内拍照。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接等待的人、事物或事件。
example_en: We had to wait for the rain to stop.
example_zh: 我们不得不等雨停下来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接令人担忧的人、事情或可能出现的情况。
example_en: Do not worry about problems that have not happened.
example_zh: 不要担心尚未发生的问题。
